19.item: Petite et accipietis (Mt 7:7 wording; apparatus Mt. 7, 1 — kept printed)
19.source: Mt 7:7 wording, noted as wording match
19.sense_relied_on: he who said Ask and ye shall receive gave each the end each desired

19.item: ad aprum subligauerat (scan $ apro — flagged: tied to the boar)
19.sense_relied_on: the hunter who tied him to the boar was gored and died; Saturus only dragged

19.item: ad ursum substrictus in ponte; ursus de cauea prodire noluit
19.sense_relied_on: bound for the bear on the bridge — the bear would not come out; recalled unhurt
